request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, soft piano, acoustic guitar, celeste, light strings, warm and hopeful mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He led me to the temple door
Water flowed beneath the floor
Running east from under stone
From the altar's side alone

[Chorus]
Water from the temple flows
Life begins where it goes
Deep and wide and strong and new
Healing all the sea so blue

[Verse]
Measuring line in his hand
Ankle deep across the land
Knee deep as we walked along
Waist deep where we belong

[Chorus]
Water from the temple flows
Life begins where it goes
Deep and wide and strong and new
Healing all the sea so blue

[Verse]
A river now too deep to cross
Swimming through the rising loss
He asked if I could see
The life that flows from me

[Chorus]
Water from the temple flows
Life begins where it goes
Deep and wide and strong and new
Healing all the sea so blue

[Bridge]
Trees on both the banks will grow
Leaves that never fade or go
Fruit each month for food and health
Fresh from God's eternal wealth

[Outro]
Where the river flows they live
Fish and trees and leaves to give
Water from the temple flows
